title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files due…
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files. This flaw enables an attacker with valid credentials to potentially modify files on the system. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
